name: bomet-ke
_comment: What this deployment SHOULD have. The profile discovers what it DOES have; this file
decides whether a gap is a bug (required -> FAIL) or legitimately N/A (absent -> SKIP).
Measured read-only against bomet on 2026-07-16. Bomet is a FLAT single tenant `ke`
(state_root = state_tenant_id = tenant_id = ke), hierarchy ADMIN, County/SubCounty/Ward.
`ke.bomet` also exists in the DB but is legacy from the original two-level bring-up that
was later collapsed; the suite targets `ke`, which is self-sufficient.

_rationale.workflow.pgr.actions.ESCALATE: ke's PGR businessService DOES define ESCALATE (2 transition rows), so #521 must actually run here — it is the deployment the feature was built for.
_rationale.mdms.rejectionReasons: Required: ke carries RAINMAKER-PGR.RejectionReasons (5 rows on 2026-11-10; it was absent when this file was first written and was a deliberate red then).
_rationale.personas.gro-with-department: Required, and still the largest gap (2026-11-10, v2.20): bomet HAS a GRO with a department in HRMS (HS_GRO, DEPT_1, per the 2026-07-16 audit), but on v2.20 every staff login goes through Keycloak and no GRO is linked to a Keycloak user (HS_GRO and HS_SU never were), so bomet.env cannot name one and GRO_USER falls back to ke-admin, which has no GRO role and no HRMS department. The declaration is right — bomet's grievance officers must be able to sign in — so this stays red until a GRO gets a Keycloak login and GRO_USER points at it. Every ASSIGN-dependent spec (pgr-lifecycle, pgr-escalation 3-12, lifecycle.setup's terminal fixtures) skips on the same reason.
_rationale.personas.csr: Required: the ward CSR that personas.ward-scoped-csr needs holds CSR, which is all this persona asks for, so #2640 must run here.
_rationale.personas.ward-scoped-csr: BOMET_CSR_CHESOEN_* exists here, so the boundary-jurisdiction #496 regression is meaningful and must not silently skip.
_rationale.locales.multi: hi_IN, en_IN, fr_FR and pt_PT all carry substantial message counts, but the suite's completeness assertions are only calibrated for en_IN — optional until they are.
_rationale.tenant.citySubTenant: Flat `ke` deployment: there is no city sub-tenant, so the configurator city-search test is genuinely N/A.
_rationale.pgr.autoEscalation: Required: ke's HRMS carries reportingTo links (the SLA reportingTo check passes there) and auto-escalation is a feature this deployment ships, so a broken chain must fail, not skip.
